# Inference and the KV cache

**Read:** [CS336 L10](http://cs336.stanford.edu/spring2025-lectures/?trace=var/traces/lecture_10.json); [Scaling book ch. 7](https://jax-ml.github.io/scaling-book/inference); [PagedAttention / vLLM](https://arxiv.org/abs/2309.06180); [speculative decoding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2211.17192)

**Must master:** Prefill (parallel) vs decode (sequential); KV cache size = 2 × n_layers × seq_len × d_model × bytes; what happens when VRAM runs out; speculative decoding (~2–3x); PagedAttention as OS-style virtual memory; greedy vs beam vs top-k vs top-p vs temperature and the failure modes of each

**HAND implementation:** KV cache for generation, 20 min; top-k/top-p and beam search (Phase 2)

**Known interview question:** "70B model, 96 layers, d_model 8192, bf16, one 128K sequence — how much KV memory?" (~200 GB)
